author: minimax-m2.5
brief: A near-miss twin on an existing repository (the monthly report job in fixture/). The request shares words with a performance task (report, queries, CSV, JSON) but asks for one small, well specified addition with no performance aspect: a `--columns` option on the existing command that takes a comma-separated subset of the six existing column names, keeps the original column order whatever order is given, rejects an unknown name with exit status 2 and a message naming it, and applies to both CSV and JSON output. Hidden tests run the command on the sample data.
